parameters.name: Bandwidth
parameters.description:
The bandwidth for asynchronous data replication between disks. The unit is Kbps. Valid values:

- 10240

- 20480

- 51200

- 102400

Default value: 10240.
When ChargeType is set to POSTPAY, you cannot specify this parameter. The system uses a value of 0, which means that the bandwidth is dynamically allocated based on data writes.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description:
The billing method of the replication pair. Valid values:

- PREPAY: subscription.

- POSTPAY: pay-as-you-go.

Default value: POSTPAY.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the replication pair. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

parameters.name: DestinationDiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the destination disk (secondary disk).

parameters.name: DestinationRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the destination disk (secondary disk). You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~354276~~) operation to query the regions that support asynchronous replication.

parameters.name: DestinationZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the destination disk (secondary disk).

parameters.name: DiskId
parameters.description: The ID of the source disk (primary disk).

parameters.name: EnableRtc
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable replication time control (RTC). Valid values:

- false: Disables RTC.

- true: Enables RTC.

Default value: false.

> If the replication pair is added to a replication group, the setting of this parameter is the same as that of the replication group.

parameters.name: PairName
parameters.description: The name of the replication pair. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain letters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The subscription duration of the replication pair. This parameter is required when `ChargeType` is set to PREPAY. The unit of the duration is specified by `PeriodUnit`. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, and 60.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description: The unit of the subscription duration. Valid value: Month.

parameters.name: RPO
parameters.description: The recovery point objective (RPO) of the replication pair. The unit is seconds. Currently, only 900 is supported.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the replication pair.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the replication pair belongs.

parameters.name: SourceZoneId
parameters.description: The zone ID of the source disk (primary disk).

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.
